build_mae_vit_base: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT base model with 768 embed dim and 12 transformer blocks
build_mae_vit_large: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT large model with 1024 embed dim and 24 transformer blocks
build_mae_vit_huge: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT huge model with 1280 embed dim and 32 transformer blocks
run_forward_encoder: run the forward encoder on video patches with random masking and positional embeddings
run_forward_decoder: run the forward decoder to reconstruct masked video patches from latent representations
